name: Wild Wild Pearls

features.name: Wild collection
features.description: Wilds on reels 1–2 collect money symbols on reels 3–6.

features.name: Full-reel multipliers
features.description: Filling a reel with money applies its multiplier.

review:
Wild Wild Pearls is an underwater collect slot. Wilds on reels one and two collect adjacent money symbols on reels 3 to 6, and reel six can also hold jackpots up to 100x.

If money symbols fill a whole reel, the total win is multiplied by the value above that reel: 2x above reels three and four, 4x above reels five and six. Wilds on reels one and two plus a Bonus or Super Bonus symbol on reel three trigger Free Spins or Super Free Spins with 10 spins and more money symbols; Super Free Spins raise the reel multipliers to 3x and 5x. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.46%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
